nets_by_tenant.name: nets_by_tenant
nets_by_tenant.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.tenant_id,
  COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count
FROM networks AS n
JOIN subnets AS s
  ON n.id = s.network_id
GROUP BY
  n.tenant_id
nets_by_tenant.description: Group networks by tenant ID and calculate subnet count.

top_ten_tenants_ports.name: top_ten_tenants_ports
top_ten_tenants_ports.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.status = 'down'
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
ORDER BY
  COUNT(p.id) DESC
LIMIT 10
top_ten_tenants_ports.description: Identify tenants in the top 10 based on distinct DOWN ports.

tenant_port_counts.name: tenant_port_counts
tenant_port_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_down_ports
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.admin_state_up = 0
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
tenant_port_counts.description: Calculate the number of distinct DOWN ports for each tenant.

tenant_subnet_counts.name: tenant_subnet_counts
tenant_subnet_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.tenant_id,
  COUNT(s.id) AS ipv4_subnets
FROM subnets s
WHERE s.ip_version = 4
GROUP BY s.tenant_id
tenant_subnet_counts.description: Calculate the number of IPv4 subnets for each tenant.

aggregate_down_ports_per_group.name: aggregate_down_ports_per_group
aggregate_down_ports_per_group.body_sql:
SELECT
  sg.id AS security_group_id,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN f.status = 'DOWN' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS average_down_port_count
FROM securitygroups AS sg
INNER JOIN firewalls AS f
  ON sg.id = f.firewall_policy_id
GROUP BY sg.id
aggregate_down_ports_per_group.description: Calculate the average number of DOWN ports per security group.

windowed_admin_state_up.name: windowed_admin_state_up
windowed_admin_state_up.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.admin_state_up,
  a.agent_type
FROM agents AS a
WHERE
  a.admin_state_up = 1
windowed_admin_state_up.description: Calculates a windowed average of admin_state_up over 2 preceding and 2 following rows, partitioned by VIF type.

down_ports_by_tenant.name: down_ports_by_tenant
down_ports_by_tenant.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  count(p.id) AS down_port_count,
  AVG(CAST(p.id AS UNSIGNED)) AS average_down_port_id
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.status = 'down'
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
down_ports_by_tenant.description: Aggregates down ports per tenant, filtering by status and standard attribute ID.

port_security_bindings.name: port_security_bindings
port_security_bindings.body_sql:
SELECT
  psb.port_id
FROM
  portsecuritybindings AS psb
port_security_bindings.description: Select ports and their security binding presence from the benchmark analysis.

tenant_ports_allocations.name: tenant_ports_allocations
tenant_ports_allocations.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  count(p.id) AS port_allocation_count
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.admin_state_up = 1
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
tenant_ports_allocations.description: Aggregates port allocations by tenant, considering only administratively up ports.

tenant_port_allocations_count.name: tenant_port_allocations_count
tenant_port_allocations_count.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  count(ia.port_id) AS total_port_allocations
FROM ports AS p
JOIN ipallocations AS ia
  ON p.id = ia.port_id
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
tenant_port_allocations_count.description: Counts the number of port allocations for each tenant.

down_ports_by_tenant_10.name: down_ports_by_tenant_10
down_ports_by_tenant_10.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  COUNT(p.id) AS down_port_count
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.admin_state_up = 0
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id

ports_filtered.name: ports_filtered
ports_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS port_id
FROM
  ports AS p
WHERE
  p.id = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034'

up_ports_by_tenant.name: up_ports_by_tenant
up_ports_by_tenant.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_port_count,
  SUM(s.cidr) AS total_ip_allocations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_floating_ip
FROM ports AS p
JOIN subnets AS s
  ON p.network_id = s.network_id
GROUP BY p.tenant_id
up_ports_by_tenant.description: Aggregates up ports by tenant, considering IP allocations and DOWN port status.

ports_port_security_rollup.name: ports_port_security_rollup
ports_port_security_rollup.body_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN psb.port_security_enabled = 1 THEN 'Enabled'
    ELSE 'Disabled'
  END AS `port_security_rollup_label`
FROM `ports` AS p
JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb
  ON p.id = psb.port_id
ports_port_security_rollup.description: Determine port-security rollup label (Enabled/Disabled) based on the filter from the previous step.

tenant_ranking.name: tenant_ranking
tenant_ranking.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id
FROM ports AS p
WHERE
  p.admin_state_up = 1
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
ORDER BY
  COUNT(p.id) DESC
tenant_ranking.description: Calculates tenant ranking based on total IP allocations on administratively up ports.

tenant_stats.name: tenant_stats
tenant_stats.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.tenant_id,
  COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.status = 'down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_down_port_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.status = 'up' THEN p.id END) AS total_up_ports,
  SUM(q.in_use + q.reserved) AS total_ip_allocations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.protocol = 'HTTP' OR v.protocol = 'HTTPS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_floating_ips
FROM
  ports p
JOIN
  vips v ON p.id = v.port_id
JOIN
  quotausages q ON v.id = q.tenant_id
GROUP BY
  p.tenant_id
tenant_stats.description: Calculates tenant-level statistics including total down ports, average down port count, total up ports, and total IP allocations.

dns_order_variance.name: dns_order_variance
dns_order_variance.body_sql:
SELECT
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN dnsnameservers.order IS NOT NULL THEN dnsnameservers.order
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS order_variance
FROM dnsnameservers
INNER JOIN subnets
  ON dnsnameservers.subnet_id = subnets.id
WHERE
  subnets.tenant_id = 'test_tenant'
dns_order_variance.description: Calculate the variance of DNS nameserver order ranges for each subnet.

subnet_subtotals.name: subnet_subtotals
subnet_subtotals.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(ipamsubnets.id) AS subnet_subtotal,
  networks.name AS subnet_name
FROM networks
JOIN ipamsubnets
  ON networks.id = ipamsubnets.id
GROUP BY
  networks.name

grand_total.name: grand_total
grand_total.description: Calculates the total count of subnets.
